subject.title: chore(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6.4.0 to 7.0.0 in the github-actions group

question: Are the successful workflow lint, benchmarks, coverage, and cross-platform Node checks sufficient evidence to accept setup-node v7 without separately exercising Pages publication and Crabbox hydration?
rationale: The implementation is correct and broadly validated, but the supplied checks do not unambiguously demonstrate two of the five changed workflow contexts.

options.title: Merge with current evidence
options.body: Accept the small residual risk because the official action remains fully SHA-pinned and all primary validation workflows passed on the exact head.

options.title: Require targeted runs
options.body: Exercise or inspect successful Pages publication and Crabbox hydration runs on this head before merging.

recommendation.title: Merge with current evidence
recommendation.body: Accept the small residual risk because the official action remains fully SHA-pinned and all primary validation workflows passed on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available repository-level routing candidate for deciding shared workflow upgrade evidence, though file-level ownership confidence is low.
